description: Version conflict: Negotiate with protocol_major = 1 is refused with Error(101)+Close(101).
preconditions: Session authenticated; state NEGOTIATING; request_id counter at 2 (auth exchange used 1).
A major mismatch would normally already fail at ALPN; this vector pins the in-band defense for a major that reaches the application anyway (spec §4.4).
assertions: Status: code 101, retryable=false, requires_repairing=false — the §6.2 registry defaults that v2.0 senders MUST equal (spec §4.2).
No detail on an in-band refusal would be allowed only pre-auth; this one still sends none, keeping the response minimal.
Client policy (spec §6.3): 101 -> no automatic reconnect; surface to user.
A minor GREATER than the Server's would also yield 101; minor <= the Server's negotiates (see control.negotiate-happy-path).
